cohort: 886 nulliparous women with dichorionic twin pregnancies
finding: Nulliparous women with a height less than the 25th percentile had a higher risk of preterm birth, low birth weight, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women with shorter stature had a 40% increased risk of Cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2500 g), very low birth weight (<1500 g)
